correctness.rationale: Conditionally on first closure at endpoint t, count t−1 early chords, of which one is complete, and n−t+1 late chords. Uniformity of the completion gives crossing probabilities 1/2 for two early chords and 1/3 for an open early chord paired with a late chord or for two late chords; the completed early chord cannot cross a late chord. This gives the polynomial in RESULT.md:24–33 for the full support 2≤t≤n+1. Subtracting the unconditional mean gives the sign boundary and the integer congruence; covariance with T is positive by strict monotonicity on a nondegenerate support. The exact survival product gives a Gaussian tail bound on the √n scale and the limit of T/(2√n) with survival exp(−x²), so moments through degree three converge after normalization. Substitution gives the stated covariance and, with Var(C)=n(n−1)(n+3)/45, the correlation constant. The latter variance also follows independently by labeled random endpoints: pairs of crossing indicators sharing a chord have covariance 1/45 from E[(2U(1−U))²]−1/9 for U uniform on (0,1); disjoint pairs are independent. Independent matching enumeration at n=2,3,7 reproduced every conditional mean; at n=7 it covered 135135 matchings. The frozen checker was inspected, not run; finite enumeration is corroboration only.
